result.instructions: Tools for intelliHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on extended leave right now?"; "Which jobs end in the next 30 days?"; "Show the open tasks for Jane Citizen.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes intelliHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run intellihr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run intellihr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run intellihr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. intellihr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: intellihr_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List the people (employees) in intelliHR as at today: name, employee number, email, phone, addresses, emergency contact, employment status, their jobs (summary) and custom fields. Filter by name (matches any part of the name), email, employee number, job id, recently updated, or who is on extended leave. Health information is never returned. GET /people.

name.description: Match any part of a person's name (case-insensitive, any name order).

job_id.description: Current job id(s), comma separated: the people who hold them.

updated_within_days.description: Only people updated within this many days.

on_extended_leave.description: true = only people on extended leave, false = only people not on extended leave.

newest_first.description: Sort by creation date, newest first (default: API order).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: One person's full record by id: names, date of birth, gender, employee number, contact details, addresses, emergency contact, employment status, jobs, work rights, user account and custom fields. Health information is never returned. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_documents
tools.title: List a person's documents
tools.description: The documents stored on a person's record (file name, type, size, upload status and a download link). Contents are not read. GET /people/{personId}/documents.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_skills
tools.title: List a person's skills
tools.description: The skills assigned to a person (with their level and review details as intelliHR returns them). The whole list comes back at once. GET /people/{personId}/skills.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_tasks
tools.title: List a person's tasks
tools.description: Tasks (forms, reviews, check-ins, onboarding steps) for a person, by tab: DUE (default), ABOUT_ME, ABOUT_OTHERS, DONE or IGNORED. GET /people/{personId}/tasks.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (roles people hold, past, current and future) as at today: person, position title, location, business unit and entity, supervisor, work type, FTE, remuneration schedule, start/end dates and status. Filter by person, job title, status (Current Job, Future Job, Ending Job, Past Job), work type, primary job, or upcoming/recent end dates. GET /jobs.

person_id.description: Person id(s), comma separated: the jobs of those people.

job_id.description: One UUID, or several separated by commas.

work_type.description: Work type name, e.g. Fixed Contract.

primary_only.description: true = only primary jobs, false = only non-primary jobs.

ending_within_days.description: Jobs with an end date in the next N days (including today).

ended_within_days.description: Jobs that ended in the last N days (including today).

newest_first.description: Sort by creation date, newest first.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id with its person, position title, location, business unit, supervisor, pay grade, remuneration and dates. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_get_job_timeline
tools.title: Get job timeline
tools.description: The upcoming changes and current information about a job (scheduled changes, end date). GET /jobs/{jobId}/timeline.

tools.name: intellihr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: The organisation's locations (sites) with parent location, code, address, enabled flag and representatives. GET /locations.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_business_units
tools.title: List business units
tools.description: The organisation's business units (departments, teams). Filter by name or identifier. GET /business-units.

name.description: Part of the business unit name.

identifier.description: The customer identifier of the unit.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_business_entities
tools.title: List business entities
tools.description: The organisation's business entities (legal employers). GET /business-entities.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_position_titles
tools.title: List position titles
tools.description: The position titles (job names) defined in intelliHR. Filter by name. GET /position-titles.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_pay_grades
tools.title: List pay grades
tools.description: The pay grades and their rates, optionally as at a date. GET /pay-grades.

as_at.description: Show the pay grades as at this point in time: an RFC3339 datetime (2026-10-01T09:00:00+10:00) or a date yyyy-mm-dd (= 00:00 UTC that day). Default now.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The user accounts that can sign in to intelliHR: username, enabled flag, permission groups and the linked person. GET /users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_custom_field_definitions
tools.title: List custom field definitions
tools.description: The custom fields defined in intelliHR (what each field on a person, job or location means and its type). GET /custom-field-definitions.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_reference_data
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: Look up one of intelliHR's reference lists: employment_conditions, work_classes, work_types, work_rights, recruitment_sources, extended_leave_types, job_change_reasons, skill_disciplines, training_types, training_providers, qualification_types, qualification_library_items, onboarding_templates, permission_groups or representative_types. Use it to find the ids and names other tools need.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_skills
tools.title: List skills
tools.description: The skills catalogue, optionally only business-critical skills or one discipline. GET /skills.

discipline_id.description: Only skills in this skill discipline (see list_reference_data kind skill_disciplines).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_qualifications
tools.title: List qualifications
tools.description: Qualification records held by people (licences, certificates) with status and dates. Filter by person, employee number or library item. GET /qualifications.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_list_trainings
tools.title: List trainings
tools.description: Training records completed or booked by people, with provider, type and dates. Filter by training name, provider, type, employee number or email. GET /trainings.

newest_first.description: Sort by creation date, newest first.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: intellihr_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person record in intelliHR (last name required). It creates the person only: no job, no user account and no welcome email is sent. A job is added separately in intelliHR. Check with list_people first to avoid duplicates. POST /people.

email_is_personal.description: true if the email is personal rather than a work address (default false).

tools.name: intellihr_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields on an existing person (only the fields you pass change): names, date of birth, gender, employee number, title and emergency contact. Contact details, addresses and jobs are not changed by this tool. PATCH /people/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_create_extended_leave
tools.title: Create extended leave
tools.description: WRITE: record extended leave (parental, long service, unpaid, etc.) on an existing job. It changes the person's employment record and can trigger intelliHR workflows. The leave is created with the end date you give as expected; finalise it in intelliHR when the person returns. Find leave types with list_reference_data kind extended_leave_types. POST /extended-leave.

job_id.description: The job the leave belongs to.

leave_type_name.description: Extended leave type name (used when no id is given).
